description: This Java class 'CalculatedFieldManagerMessageProcessor' manages calculated fields within the Thingsboard platform, handling lifecycle events, telemetry, relation changes, and scheduled reevaluations for calculated fields, including cache initialization and actor communication.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldManagerMessageProcessor
classes.description: Manages calculated fields, handling lifecycle events, telemetry, relation changes, cache initialization, and scheduled reevaluations within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the processor with actor context.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the processor, cancels scheduled tasks, and clears resources.

methods.name: onCacheInitMsg
methods.description: Handles cache initialization message, sets up entities cache, calculated fields, and schedules reevaluation.

methods.name: onStateRestoreMsg
methods.description: Restores the state of a calculated field from persisted data.

methods.name: onStatePartitionRestoreMsg
methods.description: Broadcasts state partition restore message to child actors.

methods.name: scheduleCfsReevaluation
methods.description: Schedules periodic reevaluation of calculated fields.

methods.name: onEntityLifecycleMsg
methods.description: Handles lifecycle events for entities, including creation, update, deletion, and relation changes.

methods.name: onEntityActionEventMsg
methods.description: Processes entity action events such as alarms.

methods.name: onProfileDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of profile entities.

methods.name: onTenantProfileUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to tenant profiles, reinitializing related calculated fields.

methods.name: checkCfIntervalForUpdate
methods.description: Checks and updates the reevaluation interval if changed.

methods.name: onEntityCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of entities, initializing related calculated fields.

methods.name: onEntityUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to entities, including profile changes and owner changes.

methods.name: onEntityDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of entities, removing related data and notifying actors.

methods.name: onRelationChangedEvent
methods.description: Processes relation updates or deletions affecting calculated fields.

methods.name: processRelationByDirection
methods.description: Processes relation queries in a specific direction for calculated fields.

methods.name: onCfCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of calculated fields, initializing context and actor communication.

methods.name: getCfCtx
methods.description: Creates a new context for a calculated field.

methods.name: onCfUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to calculated fields, updating context and reinitializing actors.

methods.name: onCfDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of calculated fields, cleaning up resources and notifying actors.

methods.name: onTelemetryMsg
methods.description: Processes telemetry messages, dispatching to relevant calculated field actors.

methods.name: filterAggregationCfs
methods.description: Filters calculated fields related to entity aggregation.

methods.name: findRelationsForCf
methods.description: Finds relations for a calculated field based on relation configuration.

methods.name: onLinkedTelemetryMsg
methods.description: Handles linked telemetry messages, forwarding to target entities.

methods.name: onEntityOwnerChanged
methods.description: Handles change of entity ownership, resetting arguments if needed.

methods.name: filterCalculatedFieldLinks
methods.description: Filters calculated field links relevant to a telemetry message.

methods.name: filterOwnedEntitiesCFs
methods.description: Filters calculated fields for owned entities based on telemetry.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldsByEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves calculated fields associated with an entity.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldsByEntityIdAndProfile
methods.description: Retrieves calculated fields for an entity and its profile.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldLinksByEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves links for a given entity.

methods.name: getOwnedEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities owned by a given entity.

methods.name: linkedTelemetryMsgForEntity
methods.description: Sends linked telemetry message to a specific entity actor.

methods.name: deleteRelatedEntity
methods.description: Sends delete relation message to actor.

methods.name: initRelatedEntity
methods.description: Sends init relation message to actor.

methods.name: deleteCfForEntity
methods.description: Sends delete calculated field message to actor.

methods.name: initCfForEntity
methods.description: Sends init calculated field message to actor.

methods.name: isMyPartition
methods.description: Checks if an entity belongs to the current partition.

methods.name: getProfileId
methods.description: Retrieves profile ID for an entity if applicable.

methods.name: getOrCreateActor
methods.description: Creates or retrieves actor reference for an entity.

methods.name: addLinks
methods.description: Adds links for a calculated field.

methods.name: deleteLinks
methods.description: Removes links for a calculated field.

methods.name: onPartitionChange
methods.description: Handles partition change messages.

methods.name: initCalculatedFields
methods.description: Initializes all calculated fields from storage.

methods.name: initCalculatedField
methods.description: Initializes a single calculated field.

methods.name: initCalculatedFieldLinks
methods.description: Initializes links for a calculated field.

methods.name: initEntitiesCache
methods.description: Loads entities and profiles into cache.

methods.name: updateEntityOwner
methods.description: Updates owner mapping for an entity.

methods.name: applyToTargetCfEntityActors
methods.description: Applies an action to all target entity actors for a calculated field.

methods.name: withTargetEntities
methods.description: Executes an action on target entities, considering profile and partition.

methods.name: cancelReevaluationTask
methods.description: Cancels scheduled reevaluation task.
